title: MemoryProfile
description: A governed user/agent memory profile projection, mirroring the static/dynamic user-profile pattern (long-term facts + recent activity) but where EACH entry references a MemoryArtifact/handle rather than asserting a fact inline. profiled != canonical: a profile is a projection over candidate memories, not a set of served facts. Always tenant- and container-scoped; tenant_private entries never surface on the public /memory page.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant; profile is read only within this tenant.

container.description: Project/container scope the profile is assembled within.

subject_id.description: The user/agent the profile is about.

static.description: Long-term/stable entries. Each references a MemoryArtifact/handle — NOT an inline asserted fact.

summary.description: Display-only summary; the authoritative content lives in the referenced MemoryArtifact.

dynamic.description: Recent/activity entries. Each references a MemoryArtifact/handle.
